name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
summary: Download NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning through Ollama and run it locally as a ForkMesh coding agent.

license.terms: The integration is MIT licensed; downloaded Nemotron model weights retain their upstream licence.

permissions.label: Download the selected Nemotron model from Ollama's model registry
Ask the locally installed Ollama runtime to inspect, download, and remove this model
Store the selected model's weights in Ollama's device-local model directory
Run the selected model as a coding agent in an isolated ForkMesh worktree

screenshots.alt: A blue neural network becoming a lightning bolt for Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
